target_audience: Women in distress or panic needing emotional safety and legal clarity

fonts.instructions: Import both from Google Fonts. Nunito provides friendly, rounded safety, Figtree gives high legibility for dense legal text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Cognitive ease to reduce panic.
spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFBFF] shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden relative flex flex-col

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#F0E6F7] shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px_rgba(216,180,226,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_-8px_rgba(216,180,226,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 rounded-3xl p-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#4A3254] text-white hover:bg-[#3A2642] rounded-full py-4 px-8 w-full font-semibold text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-3 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F0E6F7] text-[#4A3254] hover:bg-[#E5D5F0] rounded-full py-4 px-8 w-full font-semibold text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-3 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.emergency: bg-[#DC2626] text-white hover:bg-[#B91C1C] rounded-full py-4 px-8 w-full font-bold text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-3 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(220,38,38,0.5)] transition-all animate-[pulse_3s_ease-in-out_infinite]

inputs.text: w-full bg-[#FDFBFF] border-2 border-[#F0E6F7] focus:border-[#D8B4E2] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#D8B4E2]/20 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-[#2D2331] placeholder:text-[#6B5A74]/50 transition-all text-lg outline-none

motion.breathing_circle: animate-[breathe_8s_ease-in-out_infinite] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D8B4E2]/40 to-[#F0E6F7]/20 shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(216,180,226,0.4)]
motion.page_transition: framer-motion initial={opacity: 0, y: 15} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0} exit={opacity: 0, y: -15} transition={{duration: 0.5, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]}}

calm_waves.description: Soft gradient of blue and purple hues used for the calm screen background (use with low opacity and blur).

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react icons: Shield (Safety), Scale (Legal), Phone (Emergency), MessageCircleHeart (Chat), Wind (Calm), ArrowRight (Navigation). Apply stroke width 1.5-2.0.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA standards. Do not use light grey text; use #6B5A74 for secondary text.
accessibility.interactive: Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, links, form inputs, and interactive cards. E.g., data-testid='nav-emergency', data-testid='login-submit'.
accessibility.screen_reader: Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons. Ensure focus states use focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#D8B4E2]/40.

instructions_to_main_agent: Wrap the entire application in a centered max-w-md container (`<div className='max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFBFF] relative shadow-[0_0_50px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] flex flex-col'>`). This enforces a phone-like mobile-first UI on all screens.
Implement smooth Framer Motion page transitions for all routing.
In tailwind.config.js, configure a custom 'breathe' keyframe animation for the Calm screen that scales transform from 1 to 1.5 and back over 8 seconds.
The Calm screen should be visually minimal: a large glowing circle using the 'breathing_circle' style, pulsing slowly with text 'Breathe In' and 'Breathe Out' timed via React state or CSS.
The Chat interface must feel deeply empathetic. Use rounded bubbles (e.g., rounded-2xl rounded-bl-none for AI) and soft colors. Include quick-reply language chips.
For the Emergency Help Screen, use the 'emergency' button style with a subtle continuous pulse. Make the phone numbers large and clickable (`href='tel:xxx'`).
Never use raw 'card' classes from shadcn without heavy styling overrides. Use the defined 'components.cards.style' in this json to achieve the soft, safe, premium feel.
Include 'data-testid' attributes extensively to ensure reliable test execution.
Add 'lucide-react' and 'framer-motion' to the frontend project.
